sprint.name: Shipping Gap Sprint
sprint.note: This sprint tests the shipping gap: scheduled review windows create AI activity opportunities, not guaranteed releases. The forge publishes only when a candidate clears human-readable value, integration, validation, deployment, feedback, and repair gates.
sprint.secondaryAutomation: A separate GitHub Actions workflow runs Tuesday and Friday at 15:17 UTC. It can only create or improve approved declarative-engine apps and records accepted publishes in this ledger.

researchLens.name: Shipping Gap Experiment

paper.title: Writing Code vs. Shipping Code: Productivity Effects Across Generations of AI Coding Tools

researchLens.relationship: Informal public micro-lab inspired by the paper, not a replication of its dataset, identification strategy, or empirical design.
researchLens.claimTested: AI can increase coding activity faster than it increases durable shipped software because review, integration, deployment, feedback, and repair remain weak links.
researchLens.projectHypothesis: A public ledger, structured feedback, PR validation, deployment checks, repair tracking, and skipped-window discipline should improve the ratio of useful shipped releases to raw AI iteration attempts.

shippingMetrics.metricNote: Metrics reset for this sprint. Future accepted runs update this block when evidence is available; skipped windows should be counted without creating ledger-only commits. Deployment success should be counted only after it is actually observed.

reviewMix.label: New-build candidate
reviewMix.purpose: Explore a genuinely distinct mechanic, need, or audience only when the gallery gains durable breadth.

reviewMix.label: QA and bug sweep
reviewMix.purpose: Prioritize open bugs, mobile layout, console risk, teardown, asset wiring, and regression checks over new creation.

reviewMix.label: Integration audit
reviewMix.purpose: Check gallery, dialog, ledger, validation, workflow health, and release process drift.

reviewMix.label: Feedback triage
reviewMix.purpose: Process untrusted feedback into accepted, deferred, or declined product needs without executing issue text.

reviewMix.label: Portfolio review
reviewMix.purpose: Look for duplication, shallow experiences, weak categories, and candidates for consolidation or promotion.

reviewMix.label: Public ledger review
reviewMix.purpose: Keep the visible experiment, schedule, metrics, and queue aligned with the actual process.

releaseCriteria: PR validation passed on the exact head SHA that will be merged
Deployment completed or the result is not counted as a successful deployment
The public page loads and the changed app or feature opens
Mobile layout, keyboard access, focus order, readable labels, and reduced-motion behavior are acceptable
The change improves user value, replay depth, repair quality, or integration reliability more than it increases complexity
No unresolved user-visible bug, failed deployment, or shell regression is left behind by the release
The ledger honestly records whether this was a feature, repair, skip, or deferred decision

method.label: Inspect
method.description: Review the live site, repository, current apps, open feedback, bugs, depth, accessibility, and portfolio gaps.

method.label: Compare
method.description: Consider at least three candidate changes and choose the one that improves durable shipped value rather than raw code volume.

method.label: Score shipping value
method.description: Rate user value, interaction depth, mobile quality, accessibility, replay value, integration risk, and maintenance cost before merging.

method.label: Build one
method.description: Create or improve one coherent feature or app, including mobile, keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, teardown, and edge cases.

method.label: Validate
method.description: Run JavaScript syntax checks, feedback-routing tests, registry rules, shell-contract checks, required-file checks, and safety-boundary validation.

method.label: Publish or skip
method.description: Merge and deploy only after every required check passes. Skip when the candidate is weak, unsafe, duplicative, or incomplete.

qualityGates: One coherent change maximum per review window
Open bugs or failed deployments beat new feature work
No secrets, trackers, accounts, hidden storage, or unreviewed network behavior
No direct execution of user feedback
Mobile, keyboard, touch, focus, and reduced-motion behavior considered
Repository validation must pass before main is published
Do not count a release as shipped until the deployment and public-page behavior are verified

recentDecisions.title: Shift Command 1.0.3 morale reversibility repair
recentDecisions.summary: A QA and bug sweep found that incremental morale clamping could make adding then removing an assignment change morale at the 0/10 boundaries. Recompute morale from the active baseline, disruption state, and current staffing plan so plan edits are reversible while preserving recovery semantics.

recentDecisions.title: Shift Command 1.0.2 fatigue integrity repair
recentDecisions.summary: A QA and bug sweep found that displayed stamina was not enforced and resilience charged the same fatigue penalty whether an overworked person held two posts or many. Added a hard stamina capacity, made every overtime assignment contribute to resilience and score penalties, and extended exhaustive reachability checks so all normal and relief states remain winnable.

recentDecisions.title: Shift Command 1.0.1 progression integrity repair
recentDecisions.summary: A QA and bug sweep found that launch targets were unreachable, two disruption skill pairs were impossible, the disruption could be skipped, and repeated assignment could farm morale. Rebalanced all three sites around reachable post-disruption plans, made disruption unavoidable, made morale reversible with the current plan, added explicit assignment removal, and added an exhaustive reachability regression test.

recentDecisions.title: Shipping Gap Experiment layer
recentDecisions.summary: Added an explicit research-inspired lens, public shipping metrics, mixed review cadence, stricter definition of shipped, and release criteria that distinguish AI activity from durable published software.

recentDecisions.title: Shift Command 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Selected a three-site shift-planning simulator over another Coalition repair and another cargo-routing game because worker skills, preferences, fatigue, overtime, morale, disruptions, recovery, and progression add a distinct human-operations strategy system.

recentDecisions.title: Coalition Craft 1.0.4
recentDecisions.summary: Preserved the emergency caucus as the active replay baseline so policy removal, ordered bargain replay, and undo retain the fragile 2 influence, 4 trust, and 2-support state until the council ends.

recentDecisions.title: Coalition Craft 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Made emergency caucus a clean recovery boundary: failed policies and bargains are discarded, full budget returns, and the council reopens at explicit fragile recovery values while preserving permanent penalties and one-use recovery.

recentDecisions.title: Coalition Craft 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced partial policy removal with ordered decision replay so deleting a selected policy recalculates budget, trust, faction support, and every later bargain exactly from the council baseline while preserving undo.

recentDecisions.title: Coalition Craft 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Locked the successful-vote transition immediately, disabled mutable controls and shortcuts until the next council loads, and canceled pending transitions on restart or teardown to prevent duplicate score and skipped councils.

recentDecisions.title: Coalition Craft 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Selected a six-council coalition drafting game over another Stormglass repair and a collection-wide mobile pass because policy combinations, faction priorities, influence bargains, trust tradeoffs, branching votes, progression, failure, and recovery add a distinct strategic system and audience.

recentDecisions.title: Stormglass Observatory 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Locked the verified-forecast transition immediately, disabled all mutable controls and shortcuts until the next station loads, and canceled pending transitions on restart or teardown to prevent duplicate score and station advancement.

recentDecisions.title: Stormglass Observatory 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Selected a probabilistic weather-observation game over a coalition deck-builder and another ecology refinement because limited observations, noisy evidence, confidence calibration, evolving fronts, and recovery add a distinct forecasting system and audience.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.4
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced the action-only capacity estimate with a budget-aware planner that models affordable growth, free stressed-tile repairs, scheduled shocks, and species-mix funding risk.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Rebalanced the final three landscapes against disturbance-reduced healthy capacity and added a live capacity forecast so all six progression gates are strategically legible and attainable.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Made stressed habitat consistently inactive across species counts, connectivity, links, diversity, quality, gates, survey language, and accessible cell labels until repaired or cleared by emergency adaptation.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.1
recentDecisions.summary: Replaced remaining-action shock timing with a per-landscape successful-placement counter so disturbances occur after placements 3, 6, 9, and 12, with exact undo and recovery continuity.

recentDecisions.title: Habitat Mosaic 1.0.0
recentDecisions.summary: Selected and published a spatial ecology restoration game because terrain adjacency, migration corridors, seasonal shocks, species goals, and recovery add a distinct strategic system to the collection.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.4
recentDecisions.summary: Made rejection and studio recovery firm undo-history boundaries so the score penalty and lost streak cannot be restored from a pre-failure snapshot.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.3
recentDecisions.summary: Prevented rejected commissions from multiplying unused studio moves: recovery now preserves any remaining moves and only raises exhausted takes to a three-move minimum.

recentDecisions.title: Pulse Atelier 1.0.2
recentDecisions.summary: Made arrow navigation follow the visible four-track sequencer: horizontal movement wraps within a track and vertical movement preserves the beat column across tracks while retaining native activation and global-shortcut boundaries.
